framework.note: Mandatory public disclosure by acquirer of substantial acquisition (≥5%) or change of control; defines timing, form, and content of disclosure.
Applicability and scope of takeover regulations; defines 'acquirer', 'target company', and thresholds triggering open offer obligation.
Public announcement requirements; prescribes timing, form (PA), and disclosure of price formula for open offer.
Open offer - minimum offer price, creeping acquisition exemptions, offer period, and post-offer shareholding.
Takeover approval thresholds and shareholder voting requirements; consent of creditors for acquisition of company undertaking.
Scheme of arrangement or amalgamation machinery; relevant if acquisition structured as merger or scheme.
If acquirer is foreign entity or acquisition involves foreign capital; FEMA approval and FDI sectoral limits apply.
CCI approval required if combined assets or turnover exceed threshold (₹2,500 cr for acquisition); mandatory pre-filing.

parties: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited (acquiree)
headline: KCP Sugar and Industries files Regulation 29(2) disclosure on substantial acquisition
sum: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 29(2) on substantial acquisition of shares or takeover on 16 June 2026.
detail: The company informed NSE of a Regulation 29(2) disclosure, which mandates that any person or entity acquiring shares bringing them to 5% or higher of a company's paid-up capital must publicly disclose the acquisition, the target, consideration, and intentions. The filing itself is a regulatory gate-keeping event and marks the commencement of the takeover disclosure regime. The specific acquirer identity, shareholding %, consideration, and offer structure remain to be detailed in the scheduled form submission.
